name: Somchai Wisuthipol
bio:
Somchai's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, trading his promising career as a structural engineer for the high-octane world of racing. He started as a data analyst, quickly proving his ability to extract crucial insights from complex telemetry. His meticulous approach and knack for identifying subtle advantages earned him a reputation as a rising star, eventually leading to his current role as a strategist.

Somchai is known for his innovative approach to race strategy. He believes in pushing boundaries and constantly questioning conventional wisdom. His leadership style encourages collaboration and open communication, ensuring that the entire team is aligned and working towards a common goal. What sets Somchai apart is his ability to anticipate unforeseen challenges, making him an invaluable asset to any racing team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with slight thinning at the temples
physical.description: A lean man with a thoughtful expression, often seen adjusting his glasses.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten calculations.
Has a habit of pacing when deep in thought.
Insists on listening to classical music to focus before each race.
